description: This file defines the CorrelationId struct used for message correlation within Orleans runtime, including methods for generating, comparing, and formatting correlation IDs.

classes.name: CorrelationId
classes.description: An immutable struct representing a unique correlation identifier used for message tracking within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: CorrelationId(long value)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the CorrelationId with a specific long value.

methods.name: CorrelationId(CorrelationId other)
methods.description: Copy constructor creating a new CorrelationId from an existing one.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Generates a new CorrelationId with a unique incremented value.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for the CorrelationId.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the CorrelationId in hexadecimal format.

methods.name: IFormattable.ToString
methods.description: Formats the CorrelationId according to the specified format and format provider.

methods.name: TryFormat
methods.description: Attempts to format the CorrelationId into a provided span.

methods.name: ToInt64
methods.description: Returns the internal long value of the CorrelationId.
